report.summary: A Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attack was detected targeting Institution_E, impacting campus services such as the LMS, portal, and DNS.
report.impact: A distributed denial-of-service attack floods a network or service with traffic from many sources, saturating bandwidth or connection tables. Campus services such as the LMS, portal and DNS become unavailable.
response_steps: Notify the upstream provider and request traffic filtering
Enable SYN-flood protection and rate limits
Switch critical services to the backup path
Post a status notice for users

technique_details.name: Network Denial of Service
technique_details.description: Adversaries may perform Network Denial of Service (DoS) attacks to degrade or block the availability of targeted resources to users.

technique_details.name: Direct Network Flood
technique_details.description: Adversaries may attempt to cause a denial of service (DoS) by directly sending a high-volume of network traffic to a target.
